name: gdex
description: Agent skills and an MCP server for GDEX (gdex.pro), Gemach DAO's multi-chain trading terminal: spot swaps on Solana, Sui and EVM chains, HyperLiquid perpetuals, copy trading, limit orders, bridging and portfolio reads.
